# HOVERAir

> > HOVERAir by Zero Zero Robotics: autonomous flying cameras and self-flying drones including X1, X1 PRO, X1 PROMAX (8K), and AQUA waterproof models for hands-free content creation.

HOVERAir specializes in AI-powered autonomous drones that follow and track subjects without manual control, designed for content creators, athletes, and outdoor enthusiasts. The product line features palm-sized flying cameras with advanced tracking, gesture control, and professional-grade video capabilities from 2.7K to 8K resolution.

## Key Topics

- HOVERAir X1 PROMAX - flagship 8K autonomous drone
- HOVERAir X1 PRO - professional 4K flying camera
- HOVERAir X1 - compact pocket drone
- HOVERAir AQUA - waterproof self-flying camera
- Zero Zero Robotics - parent company
- Autonomous tracking and AI subject detection
- Hands-free recording and gesture control
- Cycling mode and sports filming
- 8K video and aerial photography
- Self-flying camera technology
- Content creation for TikTok, YouTube, Instagram
- Beacon and Joysticks accessories
- Flight modes and orbital filming
- CES 2026 product announcements
